question: Which partner should a lab screen with gefitinib next?
disclaimer: Preclinical screening triage on public NCI-ALMANAC cell-line data. Not treatment advice. Not checked by a clinician.

evidence.text:
**Mechanism:** 
Docetaxel stabilizes microtubules causing mitotic arrest, while gefitinib inhibits EGFR tyrosine kinase signaling to disrupt downstream MAPK and PI3K/Akt survival pathways. Sequential delivery can suppress chemotherapy-induced EGFR phosphorylation and cooperatively trigger apoptosis.

**Prior evidence:** 
- *Cell-line:* In NSCLC models (including PC-9, NCI-H1650, and A549), sequential treatment with docetaxel followed by gefitinib demonstrated schedule-dependent synergy, enhancing apoptosis and repressing docetaxel-induced EGFR/ERK activation (PMID: 24728492, PMID: 25474307). 
- *Early clinical:* A Phase I trial confirmed the feasibility and lack of significant pharmacokinetic interactions between docetaxel and gefitinib in advanced NSCLC (PMID: 26233803). A Phase II study in elderly patients with advanced NSCLC reported a 40% objective response rate with docetaxel plus gefitinib (PMID: 18300255). Conversely, an earlier Phase I/II study of weekly docetaxel and gefitinib in elderly NSCLC patients was stopped early due to excessive non-hematologic toxicity (PMID: 16638621).

**Safety/toxicity notes:** 
Overlapping toxicities include neutropenia, diarrhea, skin rash, fatigue, stomatitis, and elevated transaminases. 

**Evidence level:** 
Early clinical

| 10 | Vinorelbine tartrate (NSC 608210) + Gefitinib | 1 | 80.8 | [45.8, 115.8] | pair measured in another cancer |

*(Note: Any Tier 4 pairs are withheld by the ranker and never recommended because they need monotherapy measurements first.)*

### Summary
For preclinical screening triage in NSCLC cell lines, the top ranked combination partners for Gefitinib are all supported by Tier 1 evidence (pair measured in another cancer). The highest-ranked candidate is **Docetaxel + Gefitinib** (Tier 1, score 162.3, 95% interval [127.3, 197.3]), followed by **Mitoxantrone + Gefitinib** (Tier 1, score 152.4, 95% interval [117.4, 187.4]) and **Gefitinib + Cabazitaxel** (Tier 1, score 125.6, 95% interval [90.6, 160.6]). Additional Tier 1 candidates include **Vincristine sulfate + Gefitinib** (score 99.3, 95% interval [64.3, 134.3]) and **Vinblastine sulfate + Gefitinib** (score 90.4, 95% interval [55.4, 125.4]). These results are for laboratory screening prioritization only and make no claim of clinical or patient benefit.
